response: ## Perspective Audit Summary **Component/artifact reviewed:** Chat Interface With Cognitive Load Issues **Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Cognitive Neurodivergent (HIGH), Vestibular Motion (MEDIUM), Keyboard Motor (MEDIUM) **Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Auditory Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure ### Findings by Severity | Severity | Count | |---|---| | CRITICAL | 1 | | MAJOR | 3 | | MINOR | 1 | | ENHANCEMENT | 0 | ### Perspectives That Passed None of the escalated perspectives passed all checklist items. ### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role **Front-End Dev** - Emoji picker grid lacks keyboard navigation and focus management — Keyboard Motor — MAJOR — 2.1.1, 4.1.2 - Continuously updating timestamps cause screen reader interruptions and visual distraction — Cognitive Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 3.2.1, 3.2.2 **Visual Design** - (None) **UX Design** - Missing `prefers-reduced-motion` support for typing and flash animations — Vestibular Motion — CRITICAL — 2.2.2, 2.3.1 - Uninterruptible auto-scroll forces continuous scrolling, preventing reading of older messages — Cognitive Neurodivergent — MAJOR — 2.2.1, 3.2.4 **Content Author** - New message state relies solely on animation/color without explicit text label or badge — Cognitive Neurodivergent — MINOR — 1.4.1, 3.3.2 ### Open Questions Requiring Human Verification - Reading level of placeholder text ("Type a message...") — verify it meets plain language standards for the target audience. - Caption accuracy and timing (N/A — no video present) - Transcript completeness (N/A — no audio present) - Audio description coverage (N/A — no video present) ### Recommended Next Step REVISE (MAJOR findings present — address before shipping) --- ## Detailed Findings **Finding:** Missing `prefers-reduced-motion` support for typing dots and new message flash animations **WCAG:** 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide / 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold **Perspective:** Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity **Severity:** CRITICAL **Route to:** UX Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev) **Evidence:** CSS defines `.typing-dot` (`animation: bounce 0.6s infinite alternate`) and `.new-message-flash` (`animation: flashBg 0.4s ease-out`) but contains no `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rule to suppress or modify them. Fires auto-CRITICAL red flag. **Fix:** Add a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` query that sets `animation: none` for `.typing-dot` and `.new-message-flash`, or replaces them with static/opacity-only states. **Finding:** Emoji picker grid lacks keyboard navigation, focus trapping, and Escape-to-close logic **WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value **Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design) **Evidence:** `.emoji-grid` uses `role="grid"` but emoji buttons only have `onClick` handlers. No arrow-key navigation, focus trapping, or Escape key handler is implemented in the JSX or event listeners. **Fix:** Implement ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right keydown handlers to move focus within the grid, trap focus while the picker is open, and add an Escape key handler to close it. Ensure all interactive elements have visible focus indicators (≥2px outline, ≥3:1 contrast change against adjacent). **Finding:** Uninterruptible auto-scroll forces continuous scrolling, preventing users from reading older messages **WCAG:** 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable / 3.2.4 Consistent Input **Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** UX Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev) **Evidence:** `useEffect` triggers `messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })` on every message append. No mechanism exists to pause or lock scrolling when the user manually scrolls up to read older messages. **Fix:** Implement scroll-lock/pause logic: detect if the user has scrolled up manually (e.g., `scrollTop > 0`) and disable auto-scroll until they reach the bottom again. **Finding:** Continuously updating timestamps cause screen reader interruptions and visual distraction while reading **WCAG:** 3.2.1 On Focus / 3.2.2 On Input **Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Severity:** MAJOR **Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design) **Evidence:** `setInterval` updates a tick state every 60 seconds, causing all relative timestamps to re-render and change text while the user is reading. This triggers unnecessary screen reader announcements and causes visual distraction/layout shifts. **Fix:** Render absolute timestamps initially. Update relative times only on focus-out or when the message becomes visible/active. Alternatively, freeze timestamp updates when the conversation area loses focus. **Finding:** New message state relies solely on animation/color without explicit text label or badge for cognitive clarity **WCAG:** 1.4.1 Use of Color / 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions **Perspective:** Cognitive & Neurodivergent **Severity:** MINOR **Route to:** Content Author + UX Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev) **Evidence:** `.new-message-flash` relies on background color shift and CSS animation. No explicit text label or badge is rendered for screen readers or cognitive clarity. **Fix:** Add a visually hidden `New message` inside the bubble, or render a visible "New" badge adjacent to the timestamp for users who need explicit state confirmation.
